about: Expected result-block values of the Corvane feature demos, judged by tools/judge.py. Each demo writes a result block at 0x0237F000 at frame 120 (magic CVER, FNV-1a of the demo name, frame, values[13]); see docs/QA.md. Items test what the values say: documented register read-backs, hardware counters, self-checks. The screen demos capture their own output (display capture to bank D) and compare pixels with what GBATEK says, VRAM mappings are read back through their aliases, and the sound demos read the channel and capture state the ARM7 reports in its input packet (values[4..8] of those demos). What stays unjudged (the sub screen's line-start DMA bars, sound output content beyond "not silent") is listed in docs/QA.md.

sources.report:<ref>: a hardware report by a third party; gating
sources.hw:<model>: measured by us on real hardware; gating
sources.rom: decided by the ROM's own deterministic logic, independent of the emulator; gating
sources.unconfirmed: no hardware value yet; informational only, never fails the run (with --profile it is reported when it changes, not counted)

checks.same: all values equal (two or more indexes)
checks.na_when: [i, v]: the item is n/a when values[i] == v (the emulator has no such counter; DeSmuME reads 0 for the polygon counters)
checks.not_value: item field: the item fails when any of its values equals it (0xFFFF = capture did not finish)
